title: Israeli Forces Kill Eight Palestinians, Families Forced to Flee
detail: Israeli forces killed eight Palestinians in Gaza, forcing families to flee their homes in ongoing military operations.

media.caption: Israeli forces kill eight Palestinians, forcing families to flee

title: Israel Condemns Nobel Peace Prize Awarded to Navi Pillay for Gaza Inquiry
detail: Israel condemned the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay, who led the UN inquiry into the Gaza war, calling it 'grotesque anti-Israel instrumentalization.'
